name: stormglass
style_suffix: hyperdetailed, cinematic volumetric light, dramatic stormlight, moody, otherworldly

registers.name: stormclouds
registers.interior: towering thunderhead cloudscape from the air, vast billowing anvils lit from within by forks of lightning, a faint city glow far below
registers.next_target: a single silver raindrop falling away from the clouds

registers.name: raindrop
registers.interior: one enormous translucent raindrop falling in slow motion, its curved skin refracting the whole storm into ribbons of rainbow light
registers.next_target: the swirling water world suspended inside the drop

registers.name: waterworld
registers.interior: inside the raindrop, a vast underwater-like space of drifting microbubbles and glowing motes, shafts of refracted light crossing in every direction
registers.next_target: a cluster of glowing water molecules drifting in the light

registers.name: molecule
registers.interior: enormous glowing water molecules, bright pearl and crimson spheres joined at soft angles, bonds shimmering, drifting and tumbling in every direction
registers.next_target: a single radiant atom swelling huge among the molecules

registers.name: atom
registers.interior: the inside of an atom, soft hazy luminous electron probability clouds billowing like glowing fog around a distant bright nucleus
registers.next_target: a boiling web of quantum foam and luminous filaments spreading into the dark

registers.name: cosmos
registers.interior: the vast cosmic web seen from an oblique angle, irregular glowing filaments of galaxy clusters branching asymmetrically through deep darkness
registers.next_target: a luminous spiral galaxy caught in a shining filament

registers.name: galaxy
registers.interior: the inside of a spiral galaxy from a tilted angle, ragged rivers of stars and glowing nebula arms braiding past in long sweeping curves
registers.next_target: a single blazing golden star wrapped in flares of light

registers.name: star
registers.interior: the corona of a blazing star, arcs of fire and towering solar prominences with tiny planets in distant orbit
registers.next_target: a giant stormy gas planet glowing in its orbit, wrapped in banded clouds

registers.name: gasplanet
registers.interior: a colossal gas giant ahead, swirling banded storm clouds and a great glowing storm eye churning across its face
registers.next_target: towering thunderhead storm clouds lit from within by lightning, seen from the air

music_theme: A haunting, ethereal melody that swells and fades like the tides of space and time.
